description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Foreign Exchange Act. No. 12 of 2017 Order Under Section 22
categorisation: This gazette contains an order issued under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, which establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for foreign exchange transactions. It outlines specific limits, conditions, and procedures for outward remittances and investments, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
